$meta.note: Declares the TARGET six-item capability schema shape ([S-5]), NOT a snapshot of current code. The fields provenance/trust/subclass, the closed kind enum, namespaced-typed params, unified operand roles, and the serializable plugin signature are grep=0 in code today; code and schema.def are intentionally divergent, and that divergence is the tracked conformance gap the E4/E5/G6/P2 roadmap closes, not a v1 defect.

item_1_fact_record.description: [S-1] structured fact record: the fields + types carried by every capability fact. This declares field SHAPES/ENUMS, never instance content.

id.form: namespaced dotted stable identifier (e.g. rvv.v / rvv.zvfh / ime.vmadot / scalar.zbb / uarch.vrgather_slow)
id.note: id is the authoritative key; benchmark names / logs / provider identity / measured perf values must not become id (I9).

subclass.note: retains the original category (e.g. "toolchain" / "runtime-offload" / "isa-matrix-vector-backed") so closing kind to four values loses no information; a future enum split is mechanical and records as an additive minor ([S-6]). Declared-with-no-producer in v1.

status.note: in-shape typed closed field (Decision #6). missing status is interpreted as available; status takes precedence over availability ([S-2]).

provenance.note: source channel of the fact; evidence-line field (I8), does NOT participate in compute semantics. Declared-with-no-producer in v1 (producer is P2); declaring now prevents a future [F-2'] violation.

trust.note: trust level of the fact (measured vs declared); evidence-line field (I8). Declared-with-no-producer in v1 (producer is P2).

item_2_kind_enum.description: [S-1] the fact category axis. Closed enum, orthogonal to family; core passes therefore never branch on family name (I3).

mapping.policy: toolchain / runtime-offload / thread-runtime availability + build/permission gates

item_2_kind_enum.distinct_from: target_kind / region_kind (the op-classification axis, renamed commit 6e16322b). This is the capability-fact axis and is intentionally unchanged.
item_2_kind_enum.evolution: new kind values are additive-minor schema evolution ([S-6]), not runtime open extension.

item_3_relation_types.description: [S-1]/[S-2] relation-type table with per-relation semantic annotation (a typed table, not a flat three-column list). Declares the relation TYPES; the transitive-closure COMPUTATION is loading-time code and is NOT part of this shape.

provides.note: capability ids, not symbol names, not prose. lookupProviderByID resolves exact id first; otherwise an available provides/implies may satisfy. A profile is a provider carrying provides.

implies.note: transitive closure materialized once at load time ([S-2]); bounded decision routing, not a full capability lattice or inference engine.

conflicts.note: bounded bidirectional conflict query; fail-closed on hit ([S-2]). A dispatch case may reference a conflicting requirement only when carrying typed runtime_guard_required = true (records the guarded surface, does not parse a printable string).

item_4_params_namespaces.description: [S-1] namespaced, typed structured param fields (replacing the implicit free-string property map). Declares the namespace + TYPE only; concrete param VALUES are NOT in-shape.

vlen.note: raw hardware VLEN in bits (Parameter Layering Rule layer 1); not runtime thread count, dispatch guard, tensor shape, or AVL/vl.

sew_set.note: supported SEW allow-list, declared as a typed set (not a CSV string).

ime.tile.note: IME tile geometry, namespaced under ime.

item_4_params_namespaces.layering_rule_ref: Parameter Layering Rule (capability-contract.md): the hardware-fact / compile-time-variant-config / runtime-SSA / legacy-fixture layers must not cross except through an explicit compiler object or ABI surface with a declared new meaning.

item_5_plugin_interface_signature.description: [S-5] serializable projection of the ExtensionPlugin quasi-ABI signature (P-1 frozen; changes go through RFC, recorded as "extension not modification" when additive). Shallowest projection (Decision #4): ordered method name + arity + signature text of the 18 virtual member functions. The transitive request/result structs (VariantProposalRequest, VariantEmissionPlan, ...) are NOT serialized here (that is K-1's serialization effort). Plugin internal code is NOT in-shape.
item_5_plugin_interface_signature.virtual_destructor: ~ExtensionPlugin() = default (present; not counted among the 18 methods).

item_6_operand_role_vocabulary.description: [S-5] operand-role vocabulary. Decision #5: encoded as TWO ORTHOGONAL AXES, not unified by fiat. Axis A = ABI-signature slot (typed enum on the N-operand / ABI-slice route). Axis B = body-op semantic role (roles on RVVOps.td typed body ops + ConstructionProtocol). accumulator_role's value coincides with an ABI-slot spelling, but mask_role ("predicate-mask-produced-by-compare") is a body-construction role and is NOT an ABI-param slot at all — that non-coincidence is exactly why the two axes are kept distinct.

axis_body_op_semantic_role.kind: named role attributes on typed body ops

known_role_values.accumulator_role: accumulator-input-buffer (coincides with the axis-A ABI-slot spelling)
known_role_values.mask_role: predicate-mask-produced-by-compare (body-construction role; NOT an axis-A ABI slot)

item_6_operand_role_vocabulary.target_note: The [S-5] end target is one structured operand-role vocabulary with no in-table free strings. Decision #5 keeps the two axes explicit in v1 because they are genuinely orthogonal (ABI-signature slot ⟂ body-op semantic role); unification is deferred, not resolved by fiat.

not_in_shape.description: [S-5] items explicitly NOT in schema.def — these are CONTENT, not SHAPE; changing them does not touch schema.def.
items: concrete fact rows (which capabilities a particular target actually declares)
plugin internal code (only the item-5 signature shape is in-shape)
measurement library (cost lives there keyed by instance-hash; schema answers only can/what — [S-7])

profiles (a tcrv.exec.target profile is a provider carrying provides with no capability-fact kind; it expands to a normalized fact set at load — content, not shape; declared-instance-hash is taken over the expanded set)
